acceptanceCriteria: relocate --dispatch-config proves dispatcher quiescence on Windows (LockFileEx or an equivalent) or refuses with a stated platform limit that a test covers.
A snapshot verb quiesces store writers itself (or the docs name the required external quiescence step and a test refuses an unquiesced snapshot).
A live relocation qualification moves a real initialized store between two real checkouts with an active dispatcher config and records the receipts.
body: Residuals from PR beamfall/corvint#1560 (V1-2437/V1-1461, TRL-V0-001..006). `corvint-tasks relocate --dispatch-config` checks the dispatcher lock with flock, which works on darwin/linux only. No snapshot verb quiesces writers by itself. Live relocation qualification on a real store was not run. The archive export/restore round trip stays under V1-2437.
title: Tasks relocation: Windows dispatcher quiescence, self-quiescing snapshot verb, live relocation qualification
